% A \thechapter set in the preamble of a book, followed by \appendix, which
% letters the appendix chapters as in the PDF: Roman chapters, then lettered
% appendix chapters and sections, with references to each.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\renewcommand\thechapter{\Roman{chapter}}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
\chapter{Second}\label{second}
\appendix
\chapter{Extra}\label{extra}
\section{More}\label{more}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}; \ref{second}; \ref{extra}; \ref{more}.
\end{document}
